passage.title: Summer Water Restrictions
passage.body: Peringatan: Musim kemarau telah tiba. Air siap pakai akan dihilangkan. Air keran hanya untuk keperluan minum. Mohon gunakan dengan bijak. Terima kasih.

items.stem: What is the word for "water" in the notice?
items.explanation: The word for "water" in the notice is **air**. The notice mentions **air** putih and **air** keran, indicating that **air** refers to water. The other options refer to sun (**matahari**), heat (**panas**), and season (**musim**).

passage.title: Forest Fire Safety Menu
passage.body:
Hari Ini: Menu Makanan dan Minuman untuk Pemadam Kebakaran
Nasi Goreng, Sate Ayam, Es Teh, Es Jeruk

items.stem: What is the purpose of 'makanan dan minuman' in the menu?
choices: To provide food and drink to firefighters
To serve food to the public
items.explanation: The menu is for a forest fire safety event, so the purpose of 'makanan dan minuman' is to provide food and drink to firefighters, as indicated by the context of the event.

passage.title: New Road Safety Law Schedule
passage.body:
Undang-Undang Baru tentang Keselamatan Jalan Raya
Tanggal: 1 Januari 2023
Mulai berlaku: tiga bulan setelah tanggal tersebut
Tujuan: Meningkatkan keselamatan di jalan raya

items.stem: When will the new road safety law go into effect?
items.explanation: The text states that the law will go into effect 'tiga bulan setelah tanggal ini', which means 'three months after this date'.

passage.title: Port Visit Announcement
passage.body: Selamat datang di Pulau Seribu. Kedatangan: 10 Januari. Pelabuhan: Kota Tua. Waktu: 08.00-17.00. Kunjungan terbuka bagi umum.

items.stem: What is the name of the ship coming to the port?
items.explanation: The name of the ship is explicitly mentioned as "Pulau Seribu" in the text: "Selamat datang kapal Pulau Seribu."

passage.title: Earthquake Relief Center
passage.body:
PUSAT PENYALURAN BANTUAN GEMPA

Buka dari pukul 8 pagi hingga 17.00

Untuk mendapatkan makanan, air minum, dan obat-obatan

Mohon untuk berbaris dengan teratur

Terima kasih atas kerjasama Anda

items.explanation: The correct answer is "a kind of help", because the sign says "Pusat Bantuan Gempa", which means "Earthquake Relief Center", indicating that "bantuan" refers to help or aid. The other options are not mentioned or implied in the text.

passage.title: Explore Bali's Beauty Again
passage.body: Hotel Bali Indah menyambut kembali pariwisata dengan penawaran menarik. Dapatkan diskon 30% untuk pemesanan kamar hingga akhir bulan ini. Nikmati fasilitas premium dan pelayanan terbaik kami. Buru-buru, penawaran ini hanya berlaku untuk tamu mancanegara. Jangan lewatkan kesempatan untuk menikmati keindahan Bali kembali. Pesan sekarang di www.hotelbalindah.com.

items.stem: What is the purpose of the discount mentioned in the text?
choices: To encourage people to stay at the hotel longer
items.explanation: The text states 'untuk menarik wisatawan internasional' (to attract international visitors), indicating that the discount is aimed at encouraging more foreign tourists to visit Bali.

The text uses 'pulih' in the phrase 'menyambut pulih pariwisata' (welcoming the recovery of tourism), which means that 'pulih' refers to the process of tourism getting better after a difficult period.

choices: To encourage tourism recovery in Bali
To inform about new hotel regulations
To announce a special cultural event
To promote a new tourist attraction
items.explanation: The text mentions 'menyambut pulih pariwisata' (welcoming the recovery of tourism) and provides information about discounts and special packages, indicating that the purpose is to encourage tourism recovery in Bali.

passage.title: Tourism Reopens on Java
passage.body: Pemerintah Jawa membuka kembali pariwisata. Semua wisatawan dapat kembali mengunjungi tempat-tempat menarik di sini. Namun, semua harus mematuhi peraturan yang berlaku. Jaga jarak, pakai masker, dan cuci tangan. Nikmati liburan yang aman dan menyenangkan!

items.stem: What is the main message of the text?
choices: All tourist attractions are open again.
Java's tourism is now allowed to reopen.
Tourism will reopen in the next month.
Tourists must follow new safety guidelines.
items.explanation: The main message is that tourism is now allowed to reopen, as stated in 'Pemerintah Jawa membuka kembali pariwisata.' The other choices are not mentioned or are incorrect according to the text.
The word 'peraturan' is used to mean 'rules' or 'regulations' in the context of the text: 'Semua harus patuhi peraturan yang berlaku.'

passage.title: Witness the Launch of Satria
passage.body: Pantai Pasir Putih, Bali! Mari kita menonton peluncuran satelit baru, Satria! Tanggal 15 Maret, pukul 15.00 WITA. Tempat terbaik untuk menyaksikan peluncuran ini. Bawa keluarga dan teman-teman! Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, hubungi 0361-123456.

items.explanation: The text states that Satria is a 'satelit baru' (new satellite).
The text uses 'menantikan' to indicate that people are waiting for and watching the launch of Satria.

passage.title: A New Way to Drive
passage.body: Pindah ke mobil listrik sekarang dan nikmati manfaatnya! Kami menawarkan diskon 20% untuk mobil listrik baru kami. Mobil listrik kami hemat energi, ramah lingkungan, dan mudah dioperasikan. Jangan lewatkan kesempatan ini untuk mengurangi jejak karbon Anda. Datangi showroom kami hari ini juga!

items.stem: What discount does the advertisement offer on the new electric cars?
items.explanation: The advertisement states 'Diskon 20% untuk mobil listrik baru!' which means '20% discount for new electric cars!'.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of this advertisement?
choices: To offer a discount on new electric cars
To explain how electric cars work
To inform about the benefits of electric cars
To announce a new law about electric cars
items.explanation: The main purpose is to offer a discount on new electric cars, as indicated by the phrase 'Diskon 20% untuk mobil listrik baru!'.
The phrase 'hemat energi' is used to describe the electric cars, indicating that they save energy.

passage.title: New Bus Route Announcement
passage.body: Kami bangga mengumumkan rute bus terbaru kami mulai 15 Desember. Rute baru ini akan mempercepat perjalanan dari Stasiun Purwakarta ke Pasar Baru. Bus akan beroperasi setiap hari mulai pukul 6 pagi hingga 8 malam. Harganya terjangkau untuk semua penumpang. Nikmati perjalanan yang lebih nyaman dan cepat dengan kami!

items.stem: What is the word in the announcement that means "new" here?
items.explanation: The correct answer is "terbaru". The text says "rute bus terbaru", which means "the newest bus route".

items.stem: What is the purpose of the announcement?
choices: To announce a new bus route
items.explanation: The correct answer is "To announce a new bus route". The text says "Kami bangga untuk mengumumkan rute bus terbaru kami", which means "We are proud to announce our newest bus route".
